name: Plug Escape：Free Circuit Room VR
summary:
# WHOA! Dudes and Dudettes, ready to get AMPED UP with your crew?

Team up with friends in the **wacky multiplayer world of Plug Escape** and become a team of energetic plug buddies facing a **BIG problem!** This is the hilarious **co-op VR game** you've been waiting for!

Our little heroes, let's call 'em the '**Spark Squad**' (or your own awesome team name!), were just chilling, minding their own electrifying business, when **BAM! Disaster strikes!** All the super-important batteries they need to power up
